correctness.rationale: Headline claims verified independently. (1) Enumeration soundness: Enumerator A left-to-right DFS prunes only partial perms already containing a forbidden quadruple ending at the new point - safe because classical avoidance is hereditary; Enumerator B generates size-m avoiders by inserting new maximum m into size-(m-1) avoiders with naive C(m,4) standardization and no shared pruning lemma - complete because deleting the maximum preserves avoidance. Enum_fast variant's starts-with-minimum pruning reviewed line-by-line and proved sound: all three patterns start with rank 1, remaining triples are {213,132,321}, code implements exactly that case split. (2) Auditor brute-force re-enumeration with independent naive checker: n=8 total 5150 and full k-row 1,1,2,3,5,7,15,21,30,48,74,104,152 matches; n=9 total 21517 and FULL distribution (37 cells) exactly equals committed distA_n9.json; n=10 total 90921 and k<=15 row exactly matches (60s exhaustive over 3.6M perms). A==B exact agreement on every cell for n=8,9,10,11 confirmed by direct JSON comparison; n=11 total 387595 matches OEIS A257562 b-file value for the Wilf-symmetric representative. (3) Refutation: av_8^6=15>11=av_9^6 and av_10^8=26 vs av_11^8=22 confirmed in tables, violating claimed increase and stabilization; cardinality argument (15>11 so no injection Av_8^6->Av_9^6) is valid pigeonhole. (4) Obstruction witness pi=(1,3,4,5,6,7,8,2): auditor confirms pi avoids B*, inv=6, pi++(9) contains exactly 6 forbidden quadruples including (positions 0,1,7,8) values (1,3,2,9) of type 1324. (5) Shift lemmas: prepend-max proof (global max cannot be rank-1 first entry) and append-min proof (global min rank 1 vs required last ranks 4,3,2) both valid; +n inversion shift verified algebraically and on full n=8 avoider set (5150 images each, avoidance+shift+injectivity+subset-of-Av_9 all PASS, subset confirmed against brute Av_9). Corollary av_n^k<=av_{n+1}^{k+n} spot-checked with zero violations. (6) Antitone certificate k<=15: recomputed from tables, v0>=v1>=v2>=v3 holds for all k<=15, fails at k=16 (405,422,350,299), so sharp-in-window claim correct. (7) Partition agreement av_n^k=p(k) for k<=5 (1,1,2,3,5,7) and n=11 through k=8 (11,15,22) confirmed as data; draft honestly labels it empirical/conjectural, not proved. No essential inference error; proof (lemmas, refutation, cardinality) distinguished from computed certificate (decrease window, census).

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, not timestamp. Callan-Mansour arXiv:1705.00933 (fetched) proves GFs for all 1324-triples except one exceptional triple conjectured intractable - confirms B*={1324,1243,1432} is the documented gap with no GF to expand, so bivariate distribution cannot be obtained by series expansion. Claesson et al arXiv:2604.01143 (fetched) proves inversion monotonicity only for {1324,231} and {1324,2314,3214,4213}, characterizes limit sequences and determines them only for pairs {1324,p} (p length-4) plus av_n^k(1324,1342) in stable range n>=(k+7)/2 - never the triple B*; pair results do not imply triple distribution or the observed antitone direction. Bean et al arXiv:2312.07716 (fetched) proves regular insertion encodings only for height<=2 POPs - does not cover B*. OEIS A257562 (fetched) holds only univariate totals 1,1,2,6,21,79,310,1251,5150,21517,90921,387595... to n=5000 for the symmetric representative {4123,4231,4312}; OEIS search for 1324,1243,1432 returns no record - bivariate av_n^k and injection/obstruction data are unrecorded and not mechanically implied by univariate totals (Mahonian q(n,k) for n=8 at k<=7 is 1,7,27,76,174,343,602,961, far above observed rows, so avoidance restriction is substantive). The delivered claim type (refutation of increase + first antitone window + shift-lemmas with shift) differs from all priors. No prior result records the same table, witness, or lemmas.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline (refutation of admitted increase/stabilization for the literature-singled-out exceptional triple + first dual-verified bivariate census n=8..11 + certified fixed-k decrease k<=15 + two proved shift-lemmas + explicit append-max obstruction witness) is independently worth retrieving. Object B* motivated before computation as Callan-Mansour Case 237 unique intractable triple; invariant motivated by 2012 inversion-monotonicity/Stanley-Wilf program and 2026 pair-level limit-sequence phenomenon; window n=8..11/k<=20 is the natural stabilization-testable exhaustive-tractable range, not arbitrary. Value was not known (expected increase false; true direction is decrease) and not mechanically implied (univariate GF absent; Mahonian bounds far off). Future researcher attacking growth bounds, monotonicity, or insertion methods for 1324-triples reasonably needs the exact av_n^k values, the location where monotonicity breaks (k=6 cardinality obstruction), and the reusable safe-shift maps. Narrowness (one triple, finite window, computed decrease without general-n proof) does not defeat value per exact-invariant rule; draft honestly labels window limits, empirical partition observation, and OEIS coincidence, and does not claim completeness. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
